title: 五金配件出口报价单（客户采购清单 2026-11-09）
rate_source: 中国人民银行授权中国外汇交易中心《2026年11月9日人民币汇率中间价公告》，1 USD = 6.7188 CNY
source_note: 明细依据贵司 2026-11-09 手写采购清单整理（共 14 项），单价按清单所列 USD 价格录入 / Items transcribed from Buyer's handwritten purchase list dated 2026-11-09 (14 items); unit prices as listed in USD.

items.remark: 同上：带钥匙 / ditto: w/ keys

items.comment: 第 3 项 Hinge 规格手写为 .4"x3"x2.5，前导点疑为笔点，已按 4" x 3" x 2.5 录入，请核对。
第 4 项 Handle 规格手写为 .128mm, BK，前导点疑为笔点，已按 128mm, BK 录入，请核对。

items.remark: 同上：缓冲阻尼 / ditto: soft close
items.comment: 第 6 项备注手写为引号「"」（同上），按上一行展开为 soft close；Cabinet Handle 配缓冲阻尼语义存疑，请与客户确认。

followups.interpretation: 要求更优惠价格 / Buyer requests a better price
followups.action: 复核成本，给出折扣率或阶梯报价；折扣填主表折扣率栏 / Review cost, offer discount or tiered pricing

followups.interpretation: 询问最小起订量 / Asking about minimum order quantity
followups.action: 按明细 Qty 列逐型号确认 MOQ 并书面回复 / Confirm MOQ per item against the Qty column

followups.interpretation: 确认包装方式、是否需要彩盒 / Confirm packing and color-box option
followups.action: 回复默认中性出口包装及彩盒加价 / Confirm neutral export packing and color-box surcharge

followups.interpretation: 索要样品并要求快递寄送 / Samples requested by courier
followups.action: 确认样品清单、快递账号与运费承担方 / Confirm sample list, courier account and freight terms

followups.interpretation: 圈注认可价格 / Price marked as acceptable
followups.action: 维持报价竞争力并在有效期内锁定 / Keep the price competitive within the validity period

transcription_notes: 录入说明：清单备注列 3 处引号「"」表示「同上」，已按上一行展开（w/ keys、zinc、soft close）；其中第 6 项 Cabinet Handle 的「同上」指向 soft close，语义存疑，请与客户核实。手写规格 .4"x3"x2.5 与 .128mm 的前导点疑为笔点，已按 4"x3"x2.5 与 128mm 录入。左上角有一处涂黑无法辨认，已略去。 / Ditto marks expanded; item 6 needs verification. Leading dots in two specs treated as pen marks. One scribbled note was illegible and omitted.
usage_notes: 1. 浅黄色单元格为填写区；浅蓝灰单元格为公式自动计算，请勿手动覆盖。 / Yellow cells are input fields; light blue cells are formula-driven.
2. 明细区共 14 行（第 20~33 行）。如需增减，请修改输入 JSON 的 items 后重新生成，切勿手工插行（公式引用会错位）。 / 14 item rows; regenerate from JSON instead of inserting rows manually.
3. 发送客户前，请把 [ ] 占位内容替换为贵司真实信息，核对银行账号、SWIFT、贸易术语与付款方式。 / Replace all [ ] placeholders and verify bank details, Incoterms and payment terms.
4. 单价按客户手写清单原样录入；客户在清单上写有 'Need better price !!!'，如需让利请在折扣率栏填比例，总计会自动更新。 / Unit prices are transcribed as-is; enter a discount rate if you decide to concede price.
5. HS 编码、毛重、体积清单未提供，留空待补；报价前请补齐以便核算运费与报关。 / HS codes, G.W. and CBM were not on the buyer's list — fill in before quoting freight and customs.
